arxiv-2101-12611.title: Morse inequalities at infinity for a resonant mean field equation
arxiv-2101-12611.creator: Mohameden Ahmedou & \& Mohamed Ben Ayed
arxiv-2101-12611.description: Abstract In fond memory of Abbas Bahri Abstract In this paper we study the following mean field type equation (MF)\qquad-\Delta_{g}u\,=\varrho(\frac{Ke^{u}}{\int_{\Sigma}Ke^{u}dV_{g}}\,-\,1)\,\mbox{ in }\Sigma, where (\Sigma,g) is a closed oriented surface of unit volume Vol_{g}(\Sigma) = 1, K positive smooth function and \varrho=8\pi m , m\in\mathbb{N} .

arxiv-2106-05043.title: Dark Matter Effects on Compact Binary Stars
arxiv-2106-05043.creator: Ebrahim Hassani, Reza Pazhouhesh
arxiv-2106-05043.description: Abstract Abstract As compact binary star systems move inside the halo of the galaxies, they interact with dark matter particles. The interaction between dark matter particles and baryonic matter causes dark matter particles to lose some part of their kinetic energy.

arxiv-2204-13544.title: Generalizing Hybrid Integrator-Gain Systems Using Fractional Calculus
arxiv-2204-13544.creator: S. Ali Hosseini, Mohammad Saleh Tavazoei, Luke F. van Eijk, S. Hassan HosseinNia
arxiv-2204-13544.description: Abstract The Hybrid Integrator-Gain System (HIGS) has recently gained a lot of attention in control of precision motion systems. HIGS is a nonlinear low pass filter/integrator with a 52 ∘ phase advantage over its linear counterpart. This property allows us to avoid the limitations typically associated with linear controllers, like the waterbed effect and Bode’s gain-phase relation.

arxiv-2210-06729.title: A Stream Learning Approach for Real-Time Identification of False Data Injection Attacks in Cyber-Physical Power Systems
arxiv-2210-06729.creator: Ehsan Hallaji, Roozbeh Razavi-Far, Meng Wang, Mehrdad Saif, Bruce Fardanesh
arxiv-2210-06729.description: Abstract This paper presents a novel data-driven framework to aid in system state estimation when the power system is under unobservable false data injection attacks. The proposed framework dynamically detects and classifies false data injection attacks. Then, it retrieves the control signal using the acquired information.

arxiv-2210-17464.title: Visualising Generative Spaces Using Convolutional Neural Network Embeddings
arxiv-2210-17464.creator: Oliver Withington, Laurissa Tokarchuk
arxiv-2210-17464.description: Abstract As academic interest in procedural content generation (PCG) for games has increased, so has the need for methodologies for comparing and contrasting the output spaces of alternative PCG systems. In this paper we introduce and evaluate a novel approach for visualising the generative spaces of level generation systems, using embeddings extracted from a trained convolutional neural network.

arxiv-2307-01314.title: Edge-coloring a graph G G so that every copy of a graph H H has an odd color class
arxiv-2307-01314.creator: Patrick Bennett, Emily Heath, Shira Zerbib
arxiv-2307-01314.description: Abstract Recently, Alon [ 1 ] introduced the notion of an H H -code for a graph H H : a collection of graphs on vertex set [ n ] [n] is an H H -code if it contains no two members whose symmetric difference is isomorphic to H H .

arxiv-2309-01532.title: Are We Using Autoencoders in a Wrong Way?
arxiv-2309-01532.creator: Gabriele Martino, Davide Moroni, Massimo Martinelli
arxiv-2309-01532.description: Abstract Autoencoders are certainly among the most studied and used Deep Learning models: the idea behind them is to train a model in order to reconstruct the same input data. The peculiarity of these models is to compress the information through a bottleneck, creating what is called Latent Space.

arxiv-2409-05863.title: Promptable Closed-loop Traffic Simulation
arxiv-2409-05863.creator: Shuhan Tan, Boris Ivanovic, Yuxiao Chen, Boyi Li, Xinshuo Weng, Yulong Cao, Philipp Krähenbühl, Marco Pavone
arxiv-2409-05863.description: Abstract Simulation stands as a cornerstone for safe and efficient autonomous driving development. At its core a simulation system ought to produce realistic, reactive, and controllable traffic patterns. In this paper, we propose ProSim , a multimodal promptable closed-loop traffic simulation framework.

arxiv-2506-01339.title: Invariance Makes LLM Unlearning Resilient Even to Unanticipated Downstream Fine-Tuning
arxiv-2506-01339.creator: Changsheng Wang, Yihua Zhang, Jinghan Jia, Parikshit Ram, Dennis Wei, Yuguang Yao, Soumyadeep Pal, Nathalie Baracaldo, Sijia Liu
arxiv-2506-01339.description: Abstract Machine unlearning offers a promising solution to privacy and safety concerns in large language models (LLMs) by selectively removing targeted knowledge while preserving utility. However, current methods are highly sensitive to downstream fine-tuning, which can quickly recover forgotten information—even from unrelated tasks.

arxiv-2508-08176.title: Parahoric level p p -adic L L -functions for automorphic representations of GL 2 ​ n \operatorname{GL}_{2n} with Shalika models
arxiv-2508-08176.creator: Mladen Dimitrov and Andrei Jorza
arxiv-2508-08176.description: Abstract . We construct p p -adic L L -functions for regularly refined cuspidal automorphic representations of symplectic type on GL 2 ​ n \operatorname{GL}_{2n} over totally real fields, which are parahoric spherical at every finite place. Furthermore, we prove etaleness of the parabolic eigenvariety at such points and construct p p -adic L L -functions in families.

arxiv-2509-02096.title: Highly Efficient and Broadband Optical Delay Line towards a Quantum Memory
arxiv-2509-02096.creator: Yu Guo, Anindya Banerji, Jia Boon Chin, Arya Chowdhury, Alexander Ling
arxiv-2509-02096.description: Abstract We demonstrate a high-efficiency, free space optical delay line utilizing a nested multipass cell architecture. This design supports extended optical paths with low loss, aided by custom broadband dielectric coating that provides high reflectivity across a wide spectral bandwidth.

pmc-10653496.creator: Dalila Fernandes Gomes, Daniel da Silva Pereira Curado, Rosângela Maria Gomes, Betânia Ferreira Leite, Maíra Catharina Ramos, Everton Nunes da Silva, Andrzej Grzybowski, Andrzej Grzybowski, Andrzej Grzybowski, Andrzej Grzybowski
pmc-10653496.description: IntroductionAge-related macular degeneration (AMD) is an eye disease that occurs in patients over 50 years old. Early diagnosis enables timely treatment to stabilize disease progression. However, the fact that the disease is asymptomatic in its early stages can delay treatment until it progresses.

pmc-10724031.title: Long travel times from health center to hospital reduce caesarean section access: a study from Kirehe District, Rwanda
pmc-10724031.creator: Hillary Miller, Niclas Rudolfson, Theoneste Nkurunziza, Teena Cherian, Daniella Kayitesi, Christian Mazimpaka, Fredrick Kateera, Robert Riviello, Bethany Hedt-Gauthier
pmc-10724031.description: Introductiontimely access to safe cesarean section (c-section) delivery can save the lives of mothers and neonates. This paper explores how distance affects c-section access in rural sub-Saharan Africa, where women in labor present to health centers before being referred to district hospitals for surgical care.

pmc-11586421.title: Whole-cell multi-target single-molecule super-resolution imaging in 3D with microfluidics and a single-objective tilted light sheet
pmc-11586421.creator: Nahima Saliba, Gabriella Gagliano, Anna-Karin Gustavsson
pmc-11586421.description: Multi-target single-molecule super-resolution fluorescence microscopy offers a powerful means of understanding the distributions and interplay between multiple subcellular structures at the nanoscale. However, single-molecule super-resolution imaging of whole mammalian cells is often hampered by high fluorescence background and slow acquisition speeds, especially when imaging multiple targets in 3D.

pmc-13412739.title: Deciphering the Bioactive Landscape of Satureja nepeta Essential Oil: A Synergistic Exploration of Its Antimicrobial, Antiproliferative Potentials
pmc-13412739.creator: Houssam Assioui, Kaouthar Elbirgui, Othmane El Faqer, Wafaa Taha, Fatima Zahra Kadiri, Mariame Elmessal, Faiza Bennis, Jean-François Landrier, Fatima Chegdani

Gas Chromatography Mass Spectrometry (GC–MS) profiling was conducted to identify the volatile constituents of the EO.
